grammar.summary: 本课围绕广告对人的影响展开，重点运用了让步状语从句（Much as...）、so...that 结果状语从句以及定语从句 which/that。体会作者如何用 Much as 让步于「自诩鉴赏力」、用 so...that 强调饼干之大、用定语从句补充竞赛与饼干的细节。

points.title: 让步状语从句 Much as... (Concessive Clause)
points.explanation: Much as + 主语 + 谓语，表示「尽管……很……」，相当于 although 但语气更强，常置于句首。本课用 Much as we may pride ourselves on our good taste 让步于「自诩鉴赏力」，随即点出我们仍难逃广告影响。

examples.en: Much as we may pride ourselves on our good taste, we are no longer free to choose the things we want, for advertising exerts a subtle influence on us.
examples.cn: 尽管我们可以自夸自己的鉴赏力如何敏锐，但我们已经无法独立自主地选购自己所需的东西了。这是因为广告在我们身上施加着一种潜移默化的影响。

points.title: so...that 结果状语从句 (Result Clause)
points.explanation: so + 形容词/副词 + that + 从句，表示「如此……以至于……」。本课用 so heavy that a crane had to be used 强调大学生烘制的饼干重到必须用起重机卸下，凸显其「特大无比」。

examples.en: It was so heavy that a crane had to be used to remove it from the lorry.
examples.cn: 饼干份量太重了，用了一台起重机才把它从卡车上卸下。

points.title: which/that 引导的定语从句 (Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: which/that 指物引导定语从句修饰先行词。本课用 which 修饰 competitions（让人赢得巨款的竞赛）、that 修饰 biscuit（占据整个行李箱的饼干），使产品与事件的描述具体化。

examples.en: They devise hundreds of competitions which will enable us to win huge sums of money.
examples.cn: 他们设计数以百计的竞赛，竞赛中有人可赢得巨额奖金。

examples.en: a man came along with a biscuit which occupied the whole boot of his car.
examples.cn: 一个男子也带来一个大饼干，那个饼干把汽车的行李箱挤得满满的。

exercises.q: ______ we may pride ourselves on our good taste, we are no longer free to choose the things we want.
It was ______ heavy that a crane had to be used to remove it from the lorry.
They devise hundreds of competitions ______ will enable us to win huge sums of money.
用动词的适当形式填空：No one can avoid ______ (influence) by advertisements.
课文中 advertisers have made a close study of human nature 中 made a close study of 意思是？
